result.instructions: Tools for Zeevou, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which bookings arrive this week, and at which properties?"; "Show the guests who are checking out tomorrow."; "Which housekeeping tasks are still open for next weekend?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zeevou data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zeevou_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zeevou_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zeevou_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zeevou_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zeevou_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the properties (buildings or homes) in the Zeevou account, with address, status and default brand. Good first call. Zeevou API: GET /apis/properties.

is_active.description: true = only active properties, false = only inactive ones.

limit.description: Items per page (the vendor default applies when omitted).

tools.name: zeevou_get_property
tools.title: Get a property
tools.description: Get one property by id, with its address, check-in and check-out times, and amenities. Zeevou API: GET /apis/properties/{id}.

property_id.description: Numeric Zeevou id, from the matching list tool.

tools.name: zeevou_list_unit_types
tools.title: List unit types
tools.description: List unit types (the bookable room or home layouts, with bedrooms, capacity and rate plans). Zeevou API: GET /apis/unit_types.

property_id.description: Only unit types of this property id.

limit.description: Items per page (the vendor default applies when omitted).

tools.name: zeevou_get_unit_type
tools.title: Get a unit type
tools.description: Get one unit type by id, with its size, maximum capacity and amenities. Zeevou API: GET /apis/unit_types/{id}.

unit_type_id.description: Numeric Zeevou id, from the matching list tool.

tools.name: zeevou_list_units
tools.title: List units
tools.description: List the individual rentable units (the physical rooms or homes) and whether each is active. Zeevou API: GET /apis/units.

unit_type_id.description: Only units of this unit type id.

is_active.description: true = only active units, false = only inactive ones.

limit.description: Items per page (the vendor default applies when omitted).

tools.name: zeevou_get_unit
tools.title: Get a unit
tools.description: Get one unit by id, with its unit type and status. Zeevou API: GET /apis/units/{id}.

unit_id.description: Numeric Zeevou id, from the matching list tool.

tools.name: zeevou_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings, filterable by property, unit type, status, channel, guest email and arrival or departure date range. Zeevou API: GET /apis/bookings.

property_id.description: Only bookings at this property id.

unit_type_id.description: Only bookings of this unit type id.

booking_status.description: Booking status as Zeevou names it (for example, confirmed).

channel_name.description: Only bookings from this booking channel name.

guest_email.description: Only bookings of the guest with this email.

arrival_from.description: Arrival on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

arrival_to.description: Arrival on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

departure_from.description: Departure on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

departure_to.description: Departure on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

limit.description: Items per page (the vendor default applies when omitted).

tools.name: zeevou_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id, with arrival and departure dates, status, guest, property, unit type, channel and payment status. Zeevou API: GET /apis/bookings/{id}.

booking_id.description: Numeric Zeevou id, from the matching list tool.

tools.name: zeevou_list_guests
tools.title: List guests
tools.description: List guest profiles, filterable by name, email or mobile number. Zeevou API: GET /apis/guests.

limit.description: Items per page (the vendor default applies when omitted).

tools.name: zeevou_get_guest
tools.title: Get a guest
tools.description: Get one guest profile by id, with contact details and guest level. Zeevou API: GET /apis/guests/{id}.

guest_id.description: Numeric Zeevou id, from the matching list tool.

tools.name: zeevou_list_rate_plans
tools.title: List rate plans
tools.description: List rate plans (the price rules attached to unit types). Use zeevou_list_unit_types to find a unit type id. Zeevou API: GET /apis/rate_plans.

unit_type_id.description: Only rate plans of this unit type id.

limit.description: Items per page (the vendor default applies when omitted).

tools.name: zeevou_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List operational tasks (housekeeping, maintenance and similar), filterable by status, type, priority, property, booking and due date. Zeevou API: GET /apis/tasks.

status.description: Task status as Zeevou names it.

type.description: Task type as Zeevou names it.

priority.description: Task priority as Zeevou names it.

progress_status.description: Task progress status as Zeevou names it.

property_id.description: Only tasks at this property id.

booking_id.description: Only tasks linked to this booking id.

due_from.description: Tasks due on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

due_to.description: Tasks due on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

limit.description: Items per page (the vendor default applies when omitted).

tools.name: zeevou_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Get one task by id, with its subject, status, priority, deadline and linked booking. Zeevou API: GET /apis/tasks/{id}.

task_id.description: Numeric Zeevou id, from the matching list tool.

tools.name: zeevou_list_reviews
tools.title: List reviews
tools.description: List guest reviews, filterable by property, unit type, booking channel and review date range. Zeevou API: GET /apis/reviews.

property_id.description: Only reviews of this property id.

unit_type_id.description: Only reviews of this unit type id.

channel_name.description: Only reviews from this channel name.

reviewed_from.description: Reviews on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

reviewed_to.description: Reviews on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

limit.description: Items per page (the vendor default applies when omitted).

limit.description: Items per page (the vendor default applies when omitted).
